title: Dexter Jettster
subtitle: Independent
franchise: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
description: When Obi-Wan Kenobi needed help and information that the analysis Droids in the Jedi Archives couldn't help with, he went straight to this old friend Dexter Jettster. Dex owned Dex's diner on Coruscant, but he'd seen Obi-Wan's mysterious dart when he was prospecting on Subterrel. Gregarious and with a sense of humor, Dex was quick with a joke and a laugh, but willing to help his friends.
